column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan exceptions for the frontend SPA (http://localhost:5173).
# Only confirmed false positives / non-actionable findings are IGNOREd here.
# Genuine, still-open gaps (CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline', missing COEP header) are
# intentionally left as WARN so they keep showing up in the report - see docs/security-testing.md.

column3: False positive: evidence is a substring of minified keycloak-js/opentelemetry code (e.g. "in response to some user interaction or stat..."), not a developer comment leaking information.
index.html is the public SPA shell with no sensitive data; being cacheable is expected and intentional for load performance.
False positive: evidence is the base64 alphabet constant (A-Za-z0-9) used internally by a bundled library's base64 codec, not an actual encoded secret.
Modern Web Application is an informational ZAP classification tag, not a vulnerability.
Sec-Fetch-Dest is a request header set by the browser; the server has no way to set it on a response, so this rule cannot be actioned here.
